newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM Q3 net profit seen some 15 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: DSM Q3 net profit seen some 15 pct lower.

text.p: Base chemicals and plastics producer DSM NV is expected to report a third quarter net profit on Tuesday some 15 percent below the equivalent 1995 figure.
Analysts estimate third quarter earnings at 181-212 million guilders, with a consensus around 197 million, down from 234 million in the third quarter of 1995.
But they note that this would represent a modest rise in earnings per share after a 20 percent reduction in the number of ordinary shares outstanding earlier this year.

Results for the first two quarters of 1996 showed fairly sharp declines versus the year-earlier quarters because of exceptionally strong results from the hydrocarbons and polymers businesses in the first half of 1995.
Prices and margins for these products declined in the third and fourth quarters of 1995 but have been recovering since the beginning of this year.
Analysts said this and healthy contributions to earnings from EPDM synthetic rubber and the industrial chemical melamine would help to keep up the overall third quarter result.
"On balance the result will not be much below the third quarter of 1995," said Ton Gietman of Van Meer James Capel.

"Prices and underlying demand are developing favourably and there is no short-term threat from new production capacity coming onto the market," he said. Gietman believes DSM shares will perform in line with the market and rates them a "hold".
Quirijn Mulder of ING Barings says a revival of earnings should lift DSM shares to levels of 180-190 guilders soon from just below 170 now and rates them a "buy".
"The recovery will continue. Earnings will certainly be higher in 1997," he said.
